craft_notes: Sthāyin: both-remembered (unsurpassed and world-made). Rows: row 2 (flashes→goddess). Close: goddess (paradevatā as landing: to HER both belong). Rejected: picking unsurpassed over world-made — kept both (ubhaya IS the verse); 'meditate' for remember — kept remembering (anusmarat as holding-in-mind).

lines: Your matchless figure flashes — and the other, world-shaped, Mother:
both held in mind — to the good, fear-giver, boon-giver, highest goddess.
l4.sanskrit_cite: sphurati yattava rūpamanuttaraṃ yadaparaṃ ca jaganmayamambike | ubhayametadanusmaratāṃ satāmabhayade varade paradevate

reads_against.argmap: What is remembered? → Both forms remembered together: unsurpassed and world-made — to the good, fear and boon from one goddess.
c1_essence: Both forms remembered together: unsurpassed and world-made — to the good, fear and boon from one goddess.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta settling toward śānta (wonder worked into rest)
